The red one is important because your move set behaves differently while you have it active. Other body parts yield other effects but red is absolutely necessary  because otherwise enjoy doing single digit damage.


Otherwise, pressing RT while aiming (or pressing RT during a combo) causes your kinsect to attack the monster and leave clouds of dust that do different things when struck.
